messages:
maria: quick sync 12 we detected a perf/regression signal in marketplace images after an upgrade path to CUDA 12.2 + driver 540.x. need partner alignment on version pins and a controlled hotfix cadence. @alex can you summarize CI artifacts?

alex: CI shows a 10-15% p99 latency increase on batch workloads once driver 540.x is rolled. single-instance tests ok, multi-tenant queueing reproduces the spike. likely driver scheduler/timing change.

alex: repro steps in CI logs, minimal commands:```bash
# driver check
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
python tools/bench_batch.py --model gpt-4-mini --batch 8 --iters 200
```

maria: marketplace certification requires pinned stacks. suggested temporary pin: `NVIDIA driver 535.86` + `CUDA 12.1`. we should include a compat_fallback in image metadata and notify cloud & SI partners.

nvidia-eng: we'll prepare a 535.86-based hotpatch bundle with scheduler adjustments and provide checksums within business hours PST. we'll run our perf harness too.

jonathan: how should marketplace manifest represent this? extra fields?

alex: manifest example:```yaml
image: rwinference/rt-ubuntu22:2025-07-21
driver_pin: "535.86"
cuda: "12.1"
compat_fallback: ["cuda11.8-driver510"]
```

shiv: rollout plan: 1) build pinned images, 2) 5% canary (marketplace test accounts), 3) monitor latency + costs, 4) partner notice + hotfix repo. aim to canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC, full rollout in 72h if green.

maria: I'll draft partner notice with affected SKUs, pinned versions, mitigation steps, contact matrix, and escalation path. cc @nvidia-eng.

nvidia-eng: ack. we'll also produce an automated fallback package to downgrade on detection of p99 regressions. ETA ~6 hours.

deploy-bot: canary-ci/2307124100 -> FAILED :red_circle:
Logs: `batch_latency > threshold` on canary-marketplace-2
CI log: https://ci.internal/runs/2307124100/logs

alex: confirmed. nvml timingouts visible in high concurrency path. reproduces with local stress harness.

shiv: actions: alex = repro + kernel cmdline; nvidia-eng = hotpatch bundle; jonathan = manifest + marketplace gating; maria = partner notice + schedule.

maria: ops SOP for customers: if they observe p99 regressions, instruct `driver_pin: 535.86` in their image manifest and restart runtime until we validate 540.x.

jonathan: I'll add `driver_pin` to the image schema and implement a gating check in marketplace upload pipeline today.

nvidia-eng: we'll validate whether 540.x can be fixed quickly or needs a longer non-prod staging recommendation.

alex: we'll re-run KV/cache sensitive workloads once the hotpatch arrives 12 that's the worst-hit path.

maria: timeline recap: EOD PST: vendor bundles + manifest PR; TOMORROW 06:00 UTC: 5% canary; TOM+1 06:00 UTC: expand to 25% if green. I'll ping partners after PR merge.

shiv: added tasks, paging policy in case of regression. rollback path = pinned image + customer notice.

maria: I'll post partner notice draft here in ~2h. :mailbox_with_mail:
